entities.name: Cosmos
entities.description: Void between the Ten Realms of Kaldheim, a nebulous space of shifting aurora-like lights.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God of the Cosmos who took the secrets of the Cosmos monsters.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Tree in the Cosmos, origin of all life on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Cosmos monsters
entities.description: Ancient giant magical creatures that guard the World Tree.

entities.name: Toski
entities.description: Tiny, mischievous Cosmos monster, a squirrel.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: Well-known Cosmos monster in many sagas.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Passages that sometimes open between realms.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: Owner of the longboat Kaya used.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who used the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Item Tibalt used to cross the Cosmos.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Created new Omenpaths that became a multiversal phenomenon.

events.summary: Alrund makes every Cosmos monster submit to him over centuries and takes their secrets.
events.quote: the god Alrund was able to take their secrets from them

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Kaldheim's inhabitants burn the World Tree to deny Phyrexia access, but Realmbreaker creates new Omenpaths.
events.quote: Kaldheim's inhabitants burned the World Tree to deny Phyrexia access to it

relations.quote: Alrund is the god of the Cosmos
they now serve as its guardians
The Cosmos is the void between the Ten Realms of Kaldheim
